method: Rigid source timber rocks about its runners with explicit floor contact; local upholstery mesh gives separately on impact. Distinct authored runner lift, leftward scoot, recoil and tipped defeat. No generic creature wobble or invented joints.

actions.idle: Small alternating runner rock with slight cushion give.
actions.attack: Lean back and lift the leading runner, scoot left, absorb the landing in the cushion, and rock back to ready.
actions.hurt: Sharp rightward jolt, cushion compression and damped counter-rock.
actions.defeat: Chair tips onto its left side and stays on the floor with inert upholstery.

orientation.method: Source seat front and long leading runner project left. Anticipation rocks back right, attack scoots left, hurt recoils right, and the final tip falls left. No mirror or text/handedness change.
